newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTO WIN AGAIN TO OPEN UP 10-POINT LEAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTO WIN AGAIN TO OPEN UP 10-POINT LEAD.

text.p: The Portuguese league's top scorer Mario Jardel of Brazil claimed two more goals in Porto's 3-0 home win over Espinho on Sunday as his team opened up a 10-point lead.
With just nine games to go Porto have 63 points, followed by Sporting on 53 and Benfica on 47.
Porto went ahead in the 33rd minute when defender Fernando Mendes fired in a free kick.
Jardel got the second in the 70th and added the third -- his 23rd of the season -- two minutes from time.
On Saturday an early goal by captain Joao Pinto gave Benfica a 1-0 home victory over Sporting.
